Container.Name: family-vault
Container.Overview: Family Vault Beta: shared and private family photo libraries, invitations, albums, import metadata, and duplicate/blur review. The public beta starts on Free with a 500 MB installation-wide limit. Paid Pro activation and cloud backup are not available yet. Choose your own appdata and photo storage locations. Back up both before upgrades.

Config.Name: Application data
Config.Description: Database, thumbnails and local account-removal backups. Must be writable by UID 99 / GID 100.

Config.Name: Photo storage
Config.Description: Choose a dedicated writable folder on an array share, pool, Unassigned Device or share mounted in Unraid (e.g. /mnt/remotes/...). Map a host folder, not an SMB URL. Writable UID 99 / GID 100; must support normal file operations. Existing users: stop the container and move originals before changing this path. Back up originals separately from appdata.

Config.Name: Application URL
Config.Description: Exact browser URL: e.g. https://familyvault.example.com through a proxy, or http://192.168.1.20:8999 on LAN. Used for cookies, invitations and origin checks.

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: Optional SMTP server for email invitations. Without SMTP, copy invitation links manually.

Config.Name: SMTP STARTTLS
Config.Description: Use STARTTLS when connecting to SMTP.

Config.Name: SMTP sender
Config.Description: Verified sender address at your SMTP provider.

Config.Name: SMTP password
Config.Description: SMTP password; stored in the local Unraid template.

Container.License: Proprietary beta; third-party components separately licensed
Container.Requires: x86-64 CPU. Writable appdata and photo folders for UID 99 / GID 100. Read first-admin setup code from the server console. Configure APP_URL to the exact browser URL. CPU face matching, no GPU required.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: family photos memories private albums face recognition

Config.Name: Protect first administrator setup
Config.Description: Keep true. On fresh installs read /data/admin-setup-code through the server console. Existing accounts remain unchanged.

Config.Name: Import timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone used for automatic upload album names, e.g. Europe/London or America/New_York.
